title: quarena spinescens
intro: Quarena spinescens, commonly known as Quassia amara, is a plant species in the Quassia genus of the Rutaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. Quassia amara is rich in bioactive constituents such as quassin, amarogentin, and limonoids, which have been found to have therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The health benefits of Quassia amara include its potential to aid in digestion, relieve symptoms of dyspepsia, and support the immune system.
